title: Intention-friendly capability discovery
summary: Intentions discover semantic operations from currently available providers and dispatch complete domain objects; they never encode XMPP or carrier details.
invariants: SEND_MESSAGE, CHECK_PRESENCE, PUBLISH_PRESENCE and subscription semantics are exposed from currently available capabilities, not a permanent XMPP action catalogue.
An intention never constructs JIDs, stanzas, sockets, BOSH bodies or transport selectors.
Address resolution returns MessagingAddress objects before provider selection.
Removing a provider removes the corresponding transient discoverable capability.
Optional plugin services expose their own intentions without mutating the core Messaging/Presence intention set.

provenance.claim: Implements transient semantic intention discovery and dispatch.
